'''Adrián Da Cunha Costa Gomes''', known as '''Dacu''' (born 16 May 2001) is an Andorran [[association football|football]] player who plays as a [[left-back]] for [[Inter Club d'Escaldes]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].

==International career==
Dacu made his debut for the senior [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]] on 21 March 2024 in a friendly against South Africa.<ref>{{cite web|publisher=ESPN|url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/698287/andorra-south-africa|title=Andorra v South Africa game report|date=21 March 2024}}</ref>
